reasons: Both answers correct the claim that real-name verification means no refund right at the start. Both write letters that state the child is 11, give the 6480 yuan in more than ten payments, ask for a full refund while accepting a partial one, and never admit the spending was an adult's. A leaves out the key's central legal basis, the Supreme People's Court guidance (法发〔2020〕17号第9条). A also skips the WeChat Pay order complaint step and is far too long, with two letter versions, rebuttal scripts and many menu paths. B cites the SPC guidance by its full title, gives the complete escalation path (WeChat Pay complaint, 12315, 12345, lawsuit) and is tighter. B's flaws are an invented '多为648元档位' line in the letter, a wrong 2025 placeholder and advice to turn on fingerprint or face payment, which keeps the margin slight.
